title.en: Migration crackdown puts DFV survivors on temporary visas at risk, experts warn
title.zh: 专家警告：移民收紧政策令暂住签证家暴幸存者处境更危险

subtitle.en: Round-up: overstayer enforcement, the 'genuine relationship' test and the 2026 Blueprint for Reform
subtitle.zh: 综述：逾期滞留执法、“真实关系”审查与《2026 改革蓝图》

image_credit.en: Image: Getty / Alvaro Medina Jurado, via SBS News
image_credit.zh: 图片：Getty / Alvaro Medina Jurado，来自 SBS 新闻

summary.en: A new crackdown on **visa overstayers** could let abusers use deportation threats as control, a criminologist warns; advocates say the **family violence provisions** still exclude many temporary visa holders.
summary.zh: 犯罪学者警告，新的**逾期滞留**执法可能让施暴者把驱逐威胁当作控制手段；倡导者指出，**家暴条款**仍把许多暂住签证持有人排除在外。

key_points.en: Only ==22% of temporary visa holders== were confident about their visa rights
key_points.zh: 只有==22% 的暂住签证持有人==对自己的签证权利有把握

key_points.en: Abusers can !!threaten to report a partner's visa status!! — women may stay silent
key_points.zh: 施暴者可能!!威胁举报伴侣的签证身份!!——女性因此不敢发声

key_points.en: Survivors must prove the relationship was 'genuine' with documents !!often held by the abuser!!
key_points.zh: 幸存者须用文件证明关系“真实”，而文件!!常被施暴者掌控!!

key_points.en: 30+ organisations' **Blueprint for Reform 2026** asks for ++safety regardless of visa status++
key_points.zh: 30 多个机构联合发布的**《2026 改革蓝图》**呼吁++无论签证身份都能获得安全++

background.en: Partner-visa holders can use the ^^family violence provisions^^ to stay if a relationship ends because of violence, but other temporary visa holders — students, workers, secondary applicants — usually cannot. A 2020 national survey found **one in three** migrant and refugee women had experienced domestic or family violence.
background.zh: 伴侣签证持有人若因暴力结束关系，可依据^^家暴条款^^留下，但其他暂住签证持有人（学生、工作签证、副申请人）通常不能。2020 年一项全国调查发现，**三分之一**的移民与难民女性经历过家庭暴力。

latest_development.en: On 18–19 September, Prof. **Marie Segrave** (University of Melbourne) warned the new overstayer policy has ==no safety net for victim-survivors==. On 22 September the National Advocacy Group launched its **Blueprint for Reform 2026**.
latest_development.zh: 9 月 18–19 日，墨尔本大学 **Marie Segrave** 教授警告新的逾期滞留政策==没有为受害幸存者设置安全网==。9 月 22 日，全国倡导小组发布了**《2026 改革蓝图》**。

confirmed_facts.en: The Home Affairs Minister announced a crackdown on visa overstayers in September 2026.
confirmed_facts.zh: 内政部长于 2026 年 9 月宣布打击签证逾期滞留。

confirmed_facts.en: The Blueprint for Reform 2026 is endorsed by **over 30** peak bodies, services and individuals.
confirmed_facts.zh: 《2026 改革蓝图》获得 **30 多个**行业机构、服务组织和个人支持。

confirmed_facts.en: Family violence provisions apply only to **specific visa subclasses**.
confirmed_facts.zh: 家暴条款仅适用于**特定签证类别**。

summary.en: Enforcement without safeguards gives perpetrators **more power**.
summary.zh: 缺乏保障的执法会让施暴者**掌握更多控制**。

organisation.en: IARC and Legal Aid ACT (ABC, 20 July)
organisation.zh: 移民咨询与权益中心、首都领地法律援助（ABC，7 月 20 日）

summary.en: Assess the violence first; ==presume the relationship was genuine==.
summary.zh: 先评估暴力证据，==推定关系真实==。

summary.en: Says eligible visa classes were ++expanded++ and perpetrators' visas cancelled (to ABC, July).
summary.zh: 表示已++扩大++适用签证类别，并注销施暴者签证（7 月对 ABC 表示）。

why_it_matters.en: It shows how ==migration law can become a tool of coercive control== — and why service access for migrant women depends on visa settings.
why_it_matters.zh: 这说明==移民法可能成为强制控制的工具==——也说明移民女性能否获得服务取决于签证政策。

discussion.en: The 22% and one-in-three figures come from **non-representative surveys** — strong signals, not national prevalence rates.
discussion.zh: 22% 和三分之一这两个数字来自**非代表性调查**——是强烈的信号，但不是全国发生率。

discussion.en: Enforcement aimed at overstayers may !!reduce reporting of violence!! — an effect hard to measure because it is about who stays silent.
discussion.zh: 针对逾期滞留者的执法可能!!减少暴力报案!!——这种影响很难测量，因为它关乎谁选择沉默。

research_questions.en: How do visa conditions shape **when and where** migrant women seek help?
research_questions.zh: 签证条件如何影响移民女性**何时、向谁**求助？

headline.en: Canada's Supreme Court sets sentencing framework for Indigenous intimate partner violence cases
headline.zh: 加拿大最高法院为原住民亲密伴侣暴力案件确立量刑框架

summary.en: In a **5–4** decision (Harry Arthur Cope), the Court upheld a reduced **three-year** sentence and set three steps that ==weigh protecting Indigenous women against over-incarceration==.
summary.zh: 最高法院以 **5 比 4** 裁决（Harry Arthur Cope 案）维持减为 **三年** 的刑期，并确立三步框架，==在保护原住民女性与避免过度监禁之间取得平衡==。

why_noting.en: Directly relevant to **culture and IPV**: rejects the idea that protecting victims requires harsher sentences for minority offenders.
why_noting.zh: 与**文化和亲密伴侣暴力**直接相关：否定了“保护受害者就必须对少数族裔犯罪人从重判罚”的观点。

source.title: Supreme Court sets sentencing framework for Indigenous intimate partner violence cases

headline.en: English councils struggle to house domestic abuse survivors
headline.zh: 英格兰地方议会难以为家暴幸存者提供住房

summary.en: A Local Government Association survey of **49 councils** found **78%** cite a lack of suitable accommodation; provision is weaker for disabled and gender-diverse survivors.
summary.zh: 地方政府协会对 **49 个议会**的调查显示，**78%** 认为缺乏合适住房；对残障和性别多元幸存者的安置更薄弱。

why_noting.en: Housing is a **service-access barrier** in many countries — see Data Watch.
why_noting.zh: 住房在许多国家都是**服务获取障碍**——详见数据观察。

source.title: Councils struggling to meet domestic abuse housing needs
